306: theorem U_neg_sub_one (n : ℤ) : U R (-n - 1) = -U R (n - 1) := by
307:   induction n using Polynomial.Chebyshev.induct with
308:   | zero => simp
309:   | one => simp
310:   | add_two n ih1 ih2 =>
311:     have h₁ := U_add_one R n
312:     have h₂ := U_sub_two R (-n - 1)
313:     linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) 2 * (X : R[X]) * ih1 - ih2 + h₁ + h₂
314:   | neg_add_one n ih1 ih2 =>
315:     have h₁ := U_eq R n
316:     have h₂ := U_sub_two R (-n)
317:     linear_combination (norm := ring_nf) 2 * (X : R[X]) * ih1 - ih2 + h₁ + h₂

300: theorem jacobson_eq_iff_jacobson_quotient_eq_bot :
301:     I.jacobson = I ↔ jacobson (⊥ : Ideal (R ⧸ I)) = ⊥ := by
302:   have hf : Function.Surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective I
303:   constructor
304:   · intro h
305:     replace h := congr_arg (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) h
306:     rw [map_jacobson_of_surjective hf (le_of_eq mk_ker)] at h
307:     simpa using h
308:   · intro h
309:     replace h := congr_arg (comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) h
310:     rw [comap_jacobson_of_surjective hf, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)] at h
311:     simpa using h
312: 
313: /-- The standard radical and Jacobson radical of an ideal `I` of `R` are equal if and only if
314: the nilradical and Jacobson radical of the quotient ring `R/I` coincide -/
